meta.source: poolday.ai homepage + pricing page (Sept 2026); colors sampled from a 2x screenshot; theme-color read from page meta

themes.name: Dark (the only theme the site ships)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere. Pure black, sampled. Every section of poolday.ai sits on it; there is no light theme.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Active filter tab pill. Measured as #262626 on bg, with the halftone dots visibly showing through, so it is a translucent white, not a solid grey.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Intentional addition (not seen on site): placeholder fill for a video tile before its poster loads.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Hero headline, lede, wordmark, bright half of section titles, active tab label. Reads on bg (18.1:1) and surface-glass.

tokens.name: ink-nav
tokens.usage: Top-nav link labels (Home, Solutions, Integrations, Pricing, Resources) on bg. Hover goes to ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive filter tab labels and their icons; captions and fine print on bg (6.8:1) or surface-glass (4.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-quiet
tokens.usage: The muted second sentence of a two-tone section title ("Some examples here.") on bg (5.8:1). Never for small text on surface-glass.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Fill of every primary button ("Book a 15 min demo"). Off-white, a step below ink so the pill reads as an object, not a hole.

tokens.name: cta-hover
tokens.usage: Inferred hover fill for cta buttons (hover state not captured).

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Button label on a cta fill (sampled).

tokens.name: halftone-dot
tokens.usage: Brightest scan-dot of the hero halftone field (centre of the ellipse). Slightly cool: blue channel +5.

tokens.name: halftone-dot-dim
tokens.usage: Faintest scan-dot at the edge of the halftone field.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: The only brand hue declared in code (meta theme-color, Tailwind cyan-500). Not visible on the marketing page: tints mobile browser chrome. Use sparingly for focus, live states and one accent per asset, on bg (8.9:1).

tokens.name: on-brand-cyan
tokens.usage: Text or icons on a brand-cyan fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: 2px solid keyboard focus ring, 3px offset, on bg. Alias of brand-cyan.

groups.name: Marketing
groups.note: One neo-grotesk family, identified visually as Inter (single-storey g, flat terminals, tight metrics); Geist is the fallback candidate given the Next.js/Vercel stack. Display sizes are tracked tight; UI sizes are neutral. Sizes in CSS px at a 1470px viewport.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline, centred, two lines, ends with a period. Measured cap height 64px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings. Two-tone: claim in ink, follow-up sentence in ink-quiet. Measured cap height 33px.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: An AI agent that edits, generates and assembles on-brand videos.
styles.usage: The single-sentence product definition under the hero headline, in ink.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo. Set as live text, top-left of the nav, in ink.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Filter tab labels next to a 16px icon.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, both sizes, in on-cta.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Teach it your brand once: logo, fonts, colors and Lottie.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Made with brand kit + single prompt
styles.usage: Video recipe lines, fine print ("Month-to-month, no lock-in").

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Halftone dot pitch (horizontal); gap between filter tabs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Halftone row pitch; icon-to-label gap inside a tab or button.

tokens.name: gap-grid
tokens.usage: Gutter of the video grid, both axes (measured 10px exactly).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a filter tab.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Nav CTA horizontal padding; nav top inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links; hero CTA horizontal padding; headline to lede.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Lede to hero CTA.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter, left and right, at desktop width.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Hero CTA to the first section title.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Nav bottom to hero headline cap line.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Video tiles and any media frame (measured).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and tab: fully rounded ends.

size.note: Component and layout dimensions measured at a 1470px viewport.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Top bar: 24px inset, 40px control, 24px inset.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Nav CTA height (190px wide with its label).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero CTA height (206px wide).

tokens.name: control-tab
tokens.usage: Filter tab height.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside tabs and buttons.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Video grid columns; the lead tile spans 2.

tokens.name: grid-column-width
tokens.usage: One video grid column at 1470px (container 1374px).

tokens.name: hero-text-width
tokens.usage: Measured width of the lede line; keep hero copy within it.
